entries.trigger: The selected CLI release identity does not match the invoked package, executable, command, runtime, or reported version.
entries.violatedInvariant: Every CLI release field matches exact observed evidence.

entries.trigger: The exact provider, adapter, definition, or conformance profile is unavailable.
entries.violatedInvariant: One explicitly registered compatible provider selection is present.

entries.trigger: The selected provider cannot preserve a mandatory operation, authority, effect, result, disclosure, or scope boundary.
entries.violatedInvariant: The provider passes the exact conformance profile.

entries.trigger: An admitted projection, definition, adapter, or CLI binding differs from current state.
entries.violatedInvariant: Every admitted binding and generated-owned byte remains exact.

entries.trigger: Publication or removal began but complete trusted live state cannot be proven.
entries.violatedInvariant: The durable journal and every live operation prove one completed transaction.

entries.trigger: A consumer lifecycle operation targeted the Program Kit source-authoring repository.
entries.violatedInvariant: Consumer session integration runs only in an isolated consumer workspace.

entries.trigger: The invocation channel failed before a valid Program Kit result was preserved.
entries.violatedInvariant: One complete current operation-result document is obtained without provider rewriting.

entries.trigger: Verification or removal requires an exact admitted installation record that is absent.
entries.violatedInvariant: One current installation record binds the selected provider and workspace.

entries.trigger: Exact projection bytes exist but fresh provider-session discovery has not been established.
entries.violatedInvariant: A separately observed fresh session discovers the exact admitted projection.
